name: Lorlatinib
mechanism: Macrocyclic ATP-competitive ALK/ROS1 inhibitor designed for CNS penetration and to overcome most single ALK resistance mutations, including G1202R.
keyToxicities: CNS effects (cognitive, mood, speech and psychotic effects; sleep disturbance)
monitoring: Lipid profile before and during treatment, with lipid-lowering therapy as needed
Counselling of patients and carers on cognitive and mood changes
interactions: Contraindicated with strong CYP3A inducers because of serious hepatotoxicity; avoid strong CYP3A inhibitors. Lorlatinib is a moderate CYP3A inducer and lowers exposure of CYP3A substrates, including hormonal contraceptives.
resistance: Compound ALK mutations (often acquired sequentially), bypass signalling (MET amplification, MAPK alterations) and lineage plasticity.
